projectDescription: A fan-facing web app for tracking the 2026 SEC football season — including team schedules, live countdown timers, standings, and SEC Championship Game details for all 16 conference teams.
keyFeatures: Per-team schedule viewer with 13-game full season cards
Live countdown to season opener and individual game kickoffs
Conference standings table for all 16 SEC teams
SEC Championship Game details and recent champions history
Dynamic team color theming for all 16 schools
Mobile-first PWA with iOS safe area support
Home/away/conference game labels and TV network info
publicApiSurface: Team schedule data for all 16 SEC teams (Alabama, Arkansas, Auburn, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, LSU, Mississippi State, Missouri, Oklahoma, Ole Miss, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Texas A&M, Vanderbilt)
Game card fields: week, date, away team, home team, conf flag, kickoff time (ET), result status, TV network
Standings fields: team name, wins, losses, conference wins, conference losses
Championship info: date (Dec 5 2026), venue (Mercedes-Benz Stadium), location (Atlanta GA), TV (CBS), kickoff (4:00 PM ET)
Ticket search integration via SeatGeek URL
Team color palette: primary and secondary hex per school
